purpose: Normalized, deduplicated knowledge about manufacturers and their components. Sign records reference entries here by id instead of re-describing a product. Each manufacturer/component is researched once, deeply, and reused everywhere it appears.
research_scope_rule: Corpus-complete, not catalog-cloning. Document the company and the specific components that appear in the drawing corpus, plus directly relevant alternatives. Do not mirror entire vendor catalogs.

entries.name: SignComp
entries.summary: Long-standing supplier of extruded aluminum framing, cabinet, and raceway systems to the sign industry. Sells full-length extrusions or cut-and-mitered kits with corner keys and hardware included.

product_lines.name: EconoComp
product_lines.use: lightweight cabinets, slide access, smaller wall and monument signs

product_lines.name: Standard (1Part-2Part / 1P2P)
product_lines.use: medium-duty cabinets, removable retainers on three sides, also channel-letter raceways, snap frames, edge-lit LED, vandal systems

product_lines.name: Commercial
product_lines.use: heavy-duty cabinets for rigid or flex faces, hinge or slide service, radius corners and ends

product_lines.name: Architectural
product_lines.use: post-and-panel wayfinding, hingeable wall and monument cabinets, insert panel systems, monolithic edges, radius ends

entries.name: #1927 extruded aluminum sign body
entries.spec: 8in deep, 2-part extruded aluminum cabinet body profile
entries.used_for: single-faced internally illuminated cabinet sign bodies
entries.notes: Profile number and depth read from drawing; classified within SignComp's cabinet body system via research.

entries.name: K1602/32 hinge-body cabinet
entries.spec: 6in deep single-faced hinge-body extruded aluminum cabinet, welded construction
entries.used_for: wall-mounted single-faced cabinet signs with serviceable hinged face

entries.name: Indect
entries.summary: Manufacturer of parking guidance and wayfinding signage synced to its own space sensors and web-based software. Signage rated IP-65 for outdoor use, with a stated minimum 99% space-counting accuracy.

entries.name: AK 4-Digit 130 space counter display
entries.function: displays live available space count per level/zone, synced to Indect sensors and software

behavior.auto_brightness: ambient light sensor auto-dims by time of day to maintain legibility
behavior.states: can display numeric count plus OPEN / FULL / CLOSED

optical_behavior.appearance: high-contrast lit digits on dark face; green digits read as the parking-availability convention

entries.name: Matthews Paint
entries.summary: Matthews Paint (MAP), the dominant acrylic-polyurethane sign coating (since 1935, now PPG Refinish). MP-coded primers/topcoats/clears in gloss/satin/matte + metallics, conventional/Low-SVOC/Ultra-Low-VOC, color-matched to PMS/RAL across 100,000+ colors; anti-graffiti clears.

optical_behavior.appearance: Highly pigmented sign enamel in gloss/satin/matte + metallic-effect colors; strong gloss retention and color depth; clears enhance vibrancy and UV durability.

entries.name: 3M Commercial Graphics
entries.summary: 3M Commercial Graphics supplies the cast-film light-management system used corpus-wide for illuminated faces, channel letters, reflective/roadside, and etched-glass privacy: translucent color for transmitted light, blockout/diffuser for control, retroreflective sheeting for night conspicuity.

optical_behavior.appearance: 3630/3730 translucent: opaque-looking unlit, color-glow when backlit. 3635 family are light-management: blockout (-20B/-22B) masks structure/holds color, diffuser (-30/-70, ~30%+ T) evens brightness/kills hotspots, dual-color (3635-222) reads one color by day, a different color backlit. 7125/3650 opaque cast = reflected-light only (3650 metallic grey over 3630-22B blockout = metallic day face that masks light). 7725 Dusted/Frosted Crystal mimics etched glass (translucent diffuse privacy, ~85% LT). 4090 DG3 / Scotchlite 280/680 retroreflective: flat in ambient day, bright glow-back at night under headlights. 8519 luster / 8520 matte overlaminates adjust surface gloss without changing transmission.

entries.name: Oracal (Orafol)
entries.summary: ORAFOL's ORACAL line: 8800 translucent premium cast (illuminated color), 8870 blockout (light control), 651 intermediate opaque cut, 680 reflective.

optical_behavior.appearance: 8800 translucent reads solid by day, color-glows backlit; 8870 blockout masks cabinet/LED structure and builds dual-tone faces; 651 opaque (reflected-light only); 680 retroreflective (low-key by day, glow-back at night).

entries.name: Texture Plus
entries.summary: Texture Plus lightweight HDU faux wall panels (2x4ft) replicating brick/stacked stone/masonry/wood/metal; interlock or screw, saw-cut, adhesive install; 25-yr warranty, ASTM-E84 Class A; cladding for sign bases/monuments.

optical_behavior.appearance: Dimensional cast brick/stone relief with realistic mortar joints/texture; color blends sandstone tan to dark red to light gray; matte, opaque, mimics real masonry depth.

entries.name: 3A Composites (Dibond)
entries.summary: 3A Composites DIBOND — the original ACM: two 0.3mm aluminum skins on a polyethylene/mineral core; lightweight, extremely flat, rigid; painted-coil and brushed (butlerfinish) faces.
corpus_appearances: 6mm white Dibond flat-cut wall element (storefront channel-letter package)

optical_behavior.appearance: Opaque rigid panel (no transmission); optical read is its surface finish. Matte coil faces (white/black matte) are low-glare and take print flatly (even lit appearance); gloss faces more specular; butlerfinish brushed-aluminum gives a directional metallic sheen along the grain. Exceptional flatness = no oil-canning of reflected light.

entries.name: Rowmark
entries.summary: Rowmark engravable/ADA sign plastics. ADA Alternative = single-ply matte acrylic, braille-receptive/routable, made to meet ADA non-glare; appliqué 311-series (1/32in) and Value Series for tactile/braille.

optical_behavior.appearance: Matte non-reflective face meets ADA non-glare so raised tactile + braille read without specular glare; even flat opacity, high light/dark contrast between face and characters; surface takes routed tactile and drilled raster braille cleanly.

entries.name: Rowmark Clear 311-101
entries.used_for: laser-cut ADA-compliant tactile letters / clear tactile layer on interior ID signs

entries.name: NanoLumens
entries.summary: Manufacturer of direct-view LED video displays and video walls for indoor and outdoor use, across fine-to-coarse pixel pitches (roughly 0.9mm up). Indoor lines (e.g. NXT/Engage) and outdoor lines (Performance) cover fixed-install digital signage; displays are self-emissive, seamless across tiles, and rated for long service life.

entries.name: P1.87 direct-view LED display (HDS indoor / OD outdoor)
entries.spec: 1.87mm pixel pitch direct-view LED display; drawing calls indoor 'P1.87HDS' and outdoor 'P1.87OD'
entries.used_for: fine-pitch dynamic information displays in architectural surrounds

optical_behavior.appearance: self-emissive, seamless, high-contrast video surface; reads as a near-black panel when off and a saturated lit image when on; indoor brightness ~800 nits, wide viewing angle; not a backlit translucent face

entries.name: Lord (Parker Lord)
entries.summary: LORD (Parker LORD) two-part structural adhesives bonding aluminum/ACM/steel/plastics. Signlok 810 = fast-cure acrylic (8-12min working, low bondline read-through on thin/glossy panels); LORD 310 = 2K epoxy for prepared metals/rubber/urethane/plastics; bonds cladding/faces without fasteners.

entries.name: Everbrite
entries.summary: Everbrite clear solvent-based protective coatings that seal/preserve metal, masonry, and weathering (Corten) steel; on Corten it locks the patina so it won't bleed/rub off; restores/protects painted, anodized, polished, plated, brushed, patinated finishes.

optical_behavior.appearance: Clear self-leveling film that seals without obscuring the substrate; preserves the existing finish look (matte to polished) and the Corten patina rather than adding sheen.

entries.name: 3M Industrial (Bonding Solutions)
entries.summary: 3M Industrial VHB acrylic-foam double-sided tapes — fastener-free alternative to rivets/welds/screws for sign panels/stiffeners/trim. 4941 = 45-mil conformable multi-purpose gray (HSE/MSE); 4611 = 45-mil firm high-temp (pre-paint-oven); 4950 = firm general-purpose.

entries.name: 3M VHB foam tape
entries.spec: acrylic foam double-sided structural bonding tape
entries.used_for: bonding metal cladding/faces/trim in fabricated sign assemblies (e.g. stainless display surrounds)

entries.name: Cirrus full-color digital EMC panel
entries.used_for: outdoor full-color LED message panel

entries.name: SignComp Architectural Series 12 hinge body
entries.used_for: extruded aluminum hinge-body cabinet for EMC housings

entries.name: SignComp Architectural Series 7 hinge body
entries.used_for: extruded aluminum hinge-body cabinet/post-and-panel system
entries.spec: Architectural Series 7 hinge-body insert-panel system (Part #1592 body / #1666 insert retainer / #1698 end cover; kit K1592/66/98); hingeable retainers for service, concealed divider, 4/6/8in aluminum insert panels (#1674/76/78), .090 panel thickness, mill/anodized
sources: (SignComp Insert Panel System datasheet, in corpus)

entries.name: Tectonics SEG extrusion (LP 1G 02 / SP 2L 02)
entries.used_for: aluminum SEG frame/support for backlit fabric

entries.name: Zip-Change letter track
entries.used_for: changeable-letter track for reader-board cabinets

entries.name: Acrylite (Roehm)
entries.summary: Acrylite (Roehm/Evonik) cast/extruded PMMA, the illuminated-signage standard: #7328 translucent white (faces/push-through), #2447 white diffuser, 407-2 yellow, 015-2GP; LED sign grade.

optical_behavior.appearance: Milky translucent white reads as a uniform glowing face backlit; #7328 transmits ~28-32% and diffuses to hide LEDs and kill hotspots (brightness tuned by gauge). #2447 / LED sign grade push diffusion further for shallow cabinets; colored grades transmit a saturated hue. UV-stabilized (stays neutral outdoors).

entries.name: Avery Dennison
entries.summary: Avery Dennison high-performance cast cut films: SC950 opaque/metallic, SC900 (incl. decorative window/etched-glass looks), and an optically-clear grade for second-surface glass.

optical_behavior.appearance: SC950/SC900 opaque/metallic = reflected-light only, sharp cut graphics, metallics read by specular reflection (day only). Optically-clear SC950 is a transparent carrier for second-surface glass (clarity, not transmission control). SC900 decorative films give frosted/etched diffusion (privacy by scatter).

entries.name: Canon
entries.summary: Canon (Oce) wide-format printers + printable wallcovering media (textured non-woven, vinyl-coated, self-adhesive PSA), incl. IJM698 extra-fine textured wallcovering and PVC-free Type II grades; Oce Colorado inks.

optical_behavior.appearance: Fine-textured matte print surface whose subtle relief diffuses light and hides minor wall imperfections, giving printed wall graphics a non-glare finish.

entries.name: Cirrus
entries.summary: Cirrus LED Systems (US): outdoor full-color EMC panels dropped into monument/pylon message areas, 4/6/9/12mm pitch, lightweight solid-state IP67, gold wire-bonded LEDs, sensor auto-dim.

optical_behavior.appearance: Full-color 4/6/9/12mm (6mm typical for monuments/pylons); ~6,000-8,500 nits (approx, reseller-sourced) with sensor auto-dim (bright day, non-glare night); legibility ~8-40ft by pitch; IP67, ~100,000hr; reads as a saturated full-color panel embedded in the monument/pylon face.

entries.name: Dunn-Edwards
entries.summary: Dunn-Edwards Western-US architectural paint; DE/DEW/DET codes for supergraphic/large-format wall palettes. Lines: Evershield (exterior), Suprema (interior), Aristoshield.

entries.name: Equitone
entries.summary: EQUITONE (Etex) through-colored fiber-cement facade material (cement + mineral + cellulose) for ventilated rainscreen; color/texture retained at cut edges. Lunara = water-repellent high-density panel, non-repeating lunar-crater surface, subtle two-tone; architectural sign-face/wing cladding.

optical_behavior.appearance: Through-colored matte fiber-cement with randomized crater-like relief and soft two-tone shading; raw tactile mineral surface; opaque, consistent color even at cut edges.

entries.name: Jewelite
entries.summary: Jewelite (Vidon; via Gemini/sign-supply) flexible 1in trim cap securing acrylic/poly faces to channel-letter returns; 20+ colors in 150ft coils; PRO grade adds flexibility for complex letterforms — a core channel-letter component.

entries.name: P95 non-glare acrylic
entries.summary: P-95 (Plaskolite OPTIX 95) non-glare matte acrylic: matte one face, smooth reverse; meets ADA 'eggshell/matte/non-glare' surface for tactile/braille panels.

optical_behavior.appearance: One-side matte scatters specular highlights so the face throws no glare/mirror reflections (ADA non-glare) while staying near-clear for transmitted light; raised tactile + braille read cleanly without hot spots.

entries.name: P99 non-glare acrylic
entries.summary: P-99 (Plaskolite OPTIX 99) premium non-glare acrylic: ultra-light matte both faces, museum/gallery grade; meets ADA non-glare.

optical_behavior.appearance: Ultra-fine matte diffuses reflections without distorting content behind, ~90% light transmission so the face reads almost clear yet glare-free from any angle; finer/lighter matte than P-95.

entries.name: Phototex
entries.summary: Photo Tex self-adhesive removable/repositionable 100% polyester print fabric for wall graphics/murals; low-tack no-residue adhesive, reusable; aqueous/eco-solvent/solvent/latex/UV inks.

optical_behavior.appearance: Matte woven polyester fabric receiving full-color print; fine tight weave = soft textile surface, minimal glare, opaque coverage.

entries.name: Raster/Accent (raster braille)
entries.summary: Accent Signage Raster (Accent) Braille beads — uniform spheres set into drilled holes for ADA tactile braille; clear/black/white acrylic (and brass); ADA / ANSI A117.1 / CA Title 24.

optical_behavior.appearance: Each bead is a perfectly rounded dome reading tactually as a consistent dot and optically as a discrete hemisphere; clear spheres are near-transparent and read by highlight/shadow (unobtrusive), black/white chosen to match/contrast; smooth polished sphere gives a small specular highlight per dot; uniform height/reflectivity across the field.

entries.name: Solyx (Decorative Films)
entries.summary: Solyx (Decorative Films LLC) decorative window films — frosted, etched, patterned, light-diffusing PSA polyester. SX-C300 Dusted Etch is used as an etched-glass privacy treatment.

optical_behavior.appearance: SX-C300 Dusted Etch: light-grey, slightly transparent light-diffusing film mimicking sandblasted/acid-etched glass; translucent (privacy by diffusion, not blockout), no inherent lit/reflective behavior.

entries.name: Spray-Lat
entries.summary: Spraylat (a PPG brand) sign paints/coatings — sprayable enamels, anti-graffiti clears, and 'Starbright' reflective-white interior cabinet coating that brightens lit cabinet interiors. CAVEAT: the specific Starbright product page wasn't independently reachable; brand ownership verified, product role from corpus context.

optical_behavior.appearance: High-reflectance flat/matte white interior coating to maximize diffuse light bounce inside lit cabinets — a brightness amplifier, not a face color.

entries.name: Sunbrella
entries.summary: Sunbrella (Glen Raven) 100% solution-dyed acrylic performance fabric (UV/water/mildew resistant, 10-yr fade warranty). 4684 Slate = 46in, 9.25 oz/yd2, reversible awning/marine cloth; storefront/entry awnings.

optical_behavior.appearance: Woven matte solution-dyed acrylic in solid slate gray; soft canvas texture, even through-yarn color, breathable, non-reflective.

entries.name: Tempotest
entries.summary: Tempotest (Para/Para Group) highly water-repellent woven awning fabric, 100% solution-dyed acrylic with Hi-Clean coating; breathable, mildew-resistant, graphic-receptive, weldable; T416 in the awning collection (e.g. Pacific Blue).

optical_behavior.appearance: Matte woven solution-dyed acrylic canvas (solid & striped); breathable, non-reflective, even through-yarn color with water-repellent surface.

entries.name: Tremco
entries.summary: Tremco high-performance silicone glazing sealants (Spectrem line) for sign/curtainwall assemblies. Spectrem 2 = single-component medium-modulus silicone for two-sided structural glazing and perimeter/weather seals; bonds without primer to metal/glass/stone/masonry (black for structural glazing).

entries.name: Trex
entries.summary: Trex capped wood-look composite decking/cladding (95% recycled film + reclaimed sawdust, polymer shell); Transcend Havana Gold = warm caramel/honey multi-tonal teak tone; repurposed as sign-wing/fascia cladding.

optical_behavior.appearance: Matte multi-tonal wood grain in warm caramel-to-honey browns; embossed streaked grain reads as exotic teak; opaque, non-reflective.

entries.name: Band-It stainless band clamp + turnbuckle
entries.used_for: non-penetrating pole/column attachment

entries.name: Principal 12V LED + 60W power supply
entries.used_for: sign illumination

entries.name: SignComp #1391 single-face extruded cabinet + #1694 retainers
entries.used_for: extruded aluminum cabinet system

entries.name: Benjamin Moore
entries.summary: Benjamin Moore premium architectural paint; OC and other codes cited for interior sign palettes (e.g. OC-17 White Dove). Lines: Aura, Regal Select, ben; flat-semigloss.

entries.name: Creative Mines
entries.summary: Creative Mines lightweight architectural masonry/stone veneer (100% natural Pozzolan pumice, non-combustible, high freeze-thaw). Craft Board Form = handcast from rough boards exposing woodgrain/knotholes (5 colors), an alternative to poured board-form concrete; ICC-ES ESR-3685.

optical_behavior.appearance: Board-form concrete with imprinted rough woodgrain/knotholes; smooth-but-textured cementitious surface in cool grays/muted earth tones; matte, opaque, reads as architectural cast concrete.

entries.name: Harristone
entries.summary: Harristone (Salt Lake City) cast concrete stone veneer; Uintah Ledgestone = rough textures/jagged ledge edges in 10 colorways (Slate, Cape Cod, Chablis, Canmore...); veneer cladding for monument/entry-feature bases.

optical_behavior.appearance: Rough-split ledgestone courses, jagged edges, irregular stacking; multi-tonal earth blends (silver/charcoal slate, warm brown, beige/rose); matte stone surface, opaque.

entries.name: Minwax
entries.summary: Minwax penetrating oil-based wood stains/finishes for trim, doors, dimensional sign elements; Wood Finish #2716 Dark Walnut = semi-transparent brown, one-coat, ~2hr dry; on timber posts/frames/carved faces.
key_products: Wood Finish penetrating stain (Dark Walnut #2716 + tones)

optical_behavior.appearance: Semi-transparent dark brown stain that deepens grain while letting figure show through; satin penetrating finish, non-opaque.

entries.name: Precision Coating
entries.summary: Precision Coatings Inc. — specialty architectural metallic/pearlescent/iridescent polyurethane & polysiloxane finishes for high-end sign/architectural metalwork (also IR-reflective, anti-slip). NOTE: the sign-relevant entity, not the medical/thermal-spray firms of similar name.

optical_behavior.appearance: Metallic, pearlescent, and iridescent finishes that shift with light/viewing angle, in gloss to matte sheens.

entries.name: Roland DG
entries.summary: Roland DG wide-format eco-solvent/UV/resin inkjet printer-cutters + vinyl cutters, an industry color benchmark. TrueVIS (VG4-540/640, XG-640, SG3) print + contour-cut signs/decals/vehicle/window graphics with wide-gamut TR inks.

entries.name: Sherwin-Williams
entries.summary: Sherwin-Williams architectural paint; SW codes (e.g. SW7069 Iron Ore, LRV ~6) referenced for sign color-match. Industrial/sign lines include Polane 2K urethane topcoats and Pro Industrial DTM Acrylic for fabricated metal.
key_products: SW color line (SW7069 Iron Ore etc.)

entries.name: SignFoam
entries.summary: SignFoam high-density urethane (HDU) carving board for dimensional signs/3-D displays; closed-cell, naturally waterproof, uniform density, carves/routes/sandblasts/CNCs; ~15-18 lb/ft3 (denser = crisper detail).

optical_behavior.appearance: Uniform tan/off-white closed-cell foam before finishing; smooth machined or sandblasted faux-woodgrain surface that takes primer/paint; matte, opaque substrate.

entries.name: Watchfire
entries.summary: Watchfire Signs (US, Danville IL): durable full-color outdoor LED EMCs/billboards, 4-19mm pitch, silicone-potted weather-sealed modules, hardware auto-dimming.

optical_behavior.appearance: Pitch 4/6/8/10mm (close) and 12/16/19mm (elevated/roadside); peak ~up to 12,000 nits (model-dependent, some from ~7,000), high-contrast lensing reads clean at lower nits; horizontal viewing >=140deg (half-value ~70deg). 100-step photocell + software dimming: bright/saturated by day, dims to a calm night level (e.g. ~300 nit permit caps), low glare/spill.

entries.name: APCO Notifier page holder
entries.used_for: changeable paper-insert holder for ADA room IDs

entries.name: Brunner G849S H-molding
entries.used_for: 1/4in H-molding (3/4in face) for fascia-panel joints

entries.name: Colite Signature LED LP4
entries.used_for: LED module for channel letters/logos

entries.name: Daktronics DF-2053 space counter
entries.used_for: drop-in wireless live parking space-count display
entries.spec: monochrome red or green digits, 5in/7in character height, ~110deg V x 70deg H viewing, color-coded open/full

optical_behavior.appearance: Mono red/green numeric digits on a dark face, ~110x70 viewing; green vs red color-codes availability (open vs full).

entries.name: 3Form
entries.summary: 3form Varia (Ecoresin): formable architectural resin on Spectar PETG (up to 40% recycled, ~40x glass impact), with a custom interlayer (color/texture/crushed glass/capiz/botanical) suspended between resin layers — the 'sea glass' cast-resin sign panel.

optical_behavior.appearance: Translucent color-infused resin glows backlit/edge-lit and reads with depth because the interlayer floats inside the panel (layered sea-glass effect); transmits a saturated color wash while diffusing the source; finishes clear-gloss to textured; holds transmission after weathering (outdoor).

entries.name: Aristech Surfaces (Acrysteel)
entries.summary: Aristech Surfaces (Acrysteel) cast PMMA, incl. a 7328 translucent bright-white sign face cross-compatible with the industry 7328 standard; cast construction machines/thermoforms cleanly.

optical_behavior.appearance: Translucent bright white ~28-32% transmission, diffuses backlight evenly to a clean glowing face; strong opaque contrast against copy when unlit; cast resists yellowing for outdoor face life.

entries.name: Arlon Graphics
entries.summary: Arlon Graphics cast films: #236 turquoise translucent (illuminated color) and the Series 5590 85/15 perforated dual-color light-management film for first-surface channel-letter faces.

optical_behavior.appearance: #236 translucent: solid turquoise by day, turquoise glow backlit. 5590 perforated (first-surface over a translucent face): reads its solid surface color by day (black 5590-122 / white 5590-120), at night the face color shines through the perforations for a dual-color day/night read while evening the emitted light.

entries.name: Calsak Plastics (ACRYCAST)
entries.summary: Calsak Plastics distributes ACRYCAST cell-cast PMMA (superior clarity/impact vs continuous-cast/extruded), in water-clear and non-glare matte (N2); used for layered architectural sign panels and dimensional lettering.

optical_behavior.appearance: Clear grade: highly transparent, low haze, crisp polished edges so layered panels read with depth/light-piping. N2 non-glare: true matte, no sheen/reflection, kills specular glare while keeping graphics legible. UV-stable.

entries.name: Chemetal
entries.summary: Chemetal decorative real-metal/metal-look laminate sheets for sign faces/accents, incl. #909 Satin Silver Aluminum (900 anodized series); solid anodized aluminum ~0.025in, interior commercial use (not exterior/wet).

optical_behavior.appearance: Genuine satin-brushed anodized aluminum surface with a soft directional sheen and real metallic reflectivity — reads as actual brushed metal, not a printed simulation.

entries.name: Daktronics
entries.summary: Daktronics (US, Brookings SD): outdoor full-color LED EMCs/video (fine-pitch GT6x to wide-pitch Galaxy) plus the DF-2053 drop-in parking space-count display (comp-daktronics-df2053).

optical_behavior.appearance: Full-color RGB families 6/8mm fine to 16/34mm wide. Peak ~12,000 nits at 16mm to ~7,500 at 34mm; ambient auto-dim (crisp day, non-glare night). Viewing angle widens with finer pitch (16mm ~140Hx70V, 34mm ~70Hx30V). Reads as a saturated full-color video panel by day, controlled at night. DF-2053 space-counter = separate mono red/green 5in/7in digits, ~110V x 70H viewing, color-coded open/full.

entries.name: DesignTex
entries.summary: Designtex commercial wallcovering; DNA Non-Vinyl = PVC-free Type II, digitally printed by-the-yard, SCS Gold facility, strong material-health credentials (LEED/WELL/HPD/EPD).

entries.name: GKD Metal Fabrics
entries.summary: GKD Metal Fabrics weaves architectural stainless mesh as transparent sign fields/screens. Tigris (3-cable cluster + fine rod, pinstripe look) ~65% open area; used for facades, partitions, railing infill, graphic screens.

optical_behavior.appearance: Semi-transparent metallic screen (~65% open): see-through veil up close, continuous surface at distance, backgrounds/light show through. Polished stainless is specular/reflective (shimmer that shifts with viewer); regular weave can MOIRE against fine graphics or LED/media behind it; Tigris adds a directional pinstripe texture.

entries.name: Reflectiv
entries.summary: Reflectiv SAS (France, est. 1981) makes adhesive technical glazing films — solar/mirror, blackout, security, frosted/decorative. CAVEAT: its 'reflective' films are solar/mirror (one-way-mirror glare/heat rejection), NOT retroreflective traffic sheeting. If a corpus drawing needs headlight retroreflection for parking/roadside, confirm the exact SKU/brand.

optical_behavior.appearance: Solar/mirror films read one-way-mirror by day (silvered exterior, see-through interior), rejecting solar/glare — not glow-back retroreflection. Blackout grades fully opaque; frosted grades translucent diffusers.

entries.name: APCO (APCO Graphics)
entries.summary: APCO Graphics (since 1966) modular architectural sign systems with interchangeable inserts/finishes. Notifier Message Strip = extruded-aluminum machined-roller holder that auto-grips paper/card up to 1/64in for changeable notices; integrates with Arcadia/Fullview/Accord/IM systems.

entries.name: Colite Technologies
entries.summary: Colite Technologies (US, West Columbia SC) makes the Signature LED line. The LP4 low-profile module lights thin letter strokes and shallow push-through cabinet faces where deeper modules won't fit, without a trim cap. Exact lumens/beam figures sit behind the Signature LED spec book (not confirmed).

optical_behavior.appearance: Low-profile form lights very thin strokes and shallow push-through faces uniformly without a recessed source; exact lm/beam unconfirmed.

entries.name: Brunner
entries.summary: Brunner Enterprises aluminum-extrusion distributor (200+ profiles): J/F/H/T/Z channels, division bars, sign-frame extrusions, caps/coves, trim. H/J moldings join/edge fascia-band and sign panels. CAVEAT: exact part G849S not confirmable on the public site.

entries.name: Band-It (BAND-IT)
entries.summary: BAND-IT (IDEX) stainless band clamps/buckles/strapping with hand/drill tensioning (manual tension up to ~2,400 lb) for non-penetrating sign/hardware attachment to poles/columns of any diameter; 201 SS resists corrosion/vibration/wind.

entries.name: Principal LED (Principal-Sloan)
entries.summary: Principal LED (US, Abilene TX; now Principal-Sloan) makes optics-based sign LED modules. Qwik Mod (American-made, 7100K, wide diffusing lens, ~150 lm/ft on Qwik Mod 1/2 up to ~260 lm/ft on Qwik Mod 4, 24V for long runs, IP68) and the value Street Fighter / Street Fighter Colors (160deg optic).

optical_behavior.appearance: Wide-optic lenses spread light for even, hotspot-free face fill from small letters (~150 lm/ft) to large cans/backlit (~260 lm/ft) at a single warm 7100K white; Street Fighter Colors give saturated accent color through a 160deg optic.

entries.name: Tectonics
entries.summary: Tectonics extruded-aluminum frame systems paired with silicone-edge graphics (SEG) for large-format/backlit fabric; a silicone keder sewn to the fabric edge tensions into the frame channel for a smooth hardware-free face.

entries.name: Zip-Change
entries.summary: Zip-Change (Wagner) changeable rigid-letter system: scratch-resistant self-spacing acrylic letters in push-up/drop-down acrylic track adhered to readerboard faces; tracking in 8ft lengths; interchangeable with Gemini Pronto.

entries.name: SloanLED
entries.summary: SloanLED (US, Ventura CA) — established optics-based sign LED maker. Prism (12V, 3 LEDs/module, IP66/68, >60,000hr) covers white 3000-7100K + colors (~124 lm/module @1.12W, ~111 lm/W) for 3-8in cans; VL4 value series (Mini/Standard/HO, 40-130 lm/module, 2-8in); Prism24 HO is the 24V option for the largest letters/cabinets (5-12in).

optical_behavior.appearance: Patented prism optics throw a wide balanced distribution to fill the face evenly without hotspots across can depths; white Prism gives bright neutral-to-cool faces (selectable 3000-7100K), color modules light faces in saturated hues; module density tuned by depth and face material; VL4 steps output from Mini (shallow 2-3in) to HO (deep 5-8in).

key_products: Prism / Prism12 / Prism24 HO / Prism Nano

entries.name: Lumificient
entries.summary: Lumificient Corp (US, Maple Grove MN; later Nexxus Lighting) — LED illumination + drivers for signs. Hyperion R-Lite flexible LED strip for channel letters with toroidal-transformer Class-2 drivers using an 8VAC output (vs 12VDC electronic supplies). Module-level lumens/beam not exposed publicly.

optical_behavior.appearance: Hyperion R-Lite is a flexible strip run inside letters to wash the face evenly along the stroke (continuous line of light vs discrete dots); brightness/uniformity scale with run length on the matched toroidal driver. Exact lm/ft unconfirmed.

entries.name: US LED, Ltd
entries.summary: US LED, Ltd (US, Katy TX; since 2001) — channel-letter/cabinet LED modules with a 10-yr warranty, ~200,000hr L70. PointXL (PXL) evenly lights letters on 8in centers / 12in rows for 2-12in depths; 3000/4000/5000/6500K (min 70 CRI), IP67, -40 to 60C. Exact lumens/beam not published.

optical_behavior.appearance: PointXL gives wide even coverage so letters light uniformly with modules on ~8in centers / ~12in rows, filling 2-12in depths without obvious hotspots; CCT 3000-6500K. Exact lumens/beam unconfirmed.

entries.name: TMT Elektronik / TMT LEDs
entries.summary: TMT Elektronik (Türkiye; US arm Irving TX) — Game Changer sign LED modules. Flagship Platinum Midi 4 uses CrystaLens optics for a 170deg viewing angle, 240-320 lumens/module at up to ~155 lm/W (1.7-2W, 12/24V), for large channel letters (3-6in) and cabinets (2-10in from face); cuts module count ~3x and power ~30%.

optical_behavior.appearance: CrystaLens 170deg distribution floods the face with bright even light and no hotspots even when widely spaced (standard 12in OC, 1 module/ft); at 240-320 lm/module it lights large letters/deep cabinets with ~1/3 the modules; 7.5-25cm (3-10in) depths, 6500K white.

entries.name: Game Changer Platinum Midi 4 LED module
entries.spec: CrystaLens 170deg viewing angle, 240-320 lm/module, up to ~155 lm/W @2W, 12/24V; channel letters 3-6in deep, cabinets 2-10in from face
entries.used_for: even hotspot-free illumination of large channel letters and sign cabinets

optical_behavior.appearance: Extremely wide 170deg spread floods deep faces evenly with no hotspots at ~1 module/ft; high per-module output reduces count ~3x vs conventional layouts.

entries.name: EveryLite
entries.summary: EveryLite (US, Orlando FL) — LED sign power supplies, modules, channel-letter systems. Class-2 12V supplies incl. JUL-60-12 (60W, IP68, ~85% eff, 100-277VAC w/ PFC, UL8750/1310/879, ~30,000hr MTBF) and EVE-180-12-II-K (180W, IP68 silicone-encapsulated metal case, 100-305VAC active PFC, -40F to +122F, 5-yr warranty); built for outdoor dry/damp/wet service.

entries.name: JUL-60-12 LED power supply
entries.spec: 60W, 12V, 5A, Class-2, IP68, 100-277VAC input w/ PFC, ~85% efficiency, UL8750/1310/879, ~30,000hr MTBF, -? to +? outdoor
entries.used_for: low-voltage DC supply for sign LED modules/strips (small-medium runs)

entries.name: EVE-180-12-II-K LED power supply
entries.spec: 180W, 12V, Class-2, IP68 silicone-encapsulated aluminum case, 100-305VAC active PFC (PF>=0.9), -40F to +122F, UL/CE/FCC, 5-yr warranty
entries.used_for: low-voltage DC supply for larger sign LED loads / long runs, outdoor
